change.source: finding 3 (the fixture key leaves out the repository's .cargo/config.toml and the environment that reaches the build): round 2 (bd89461): the key holds the bytes of .cargo/config.toml (a marker when the file is absent) and the values of RUSTFLAGS and CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS as the test process sees them (a marker for an unset one, so an empty value is another key than an absent one); 3 unit cases with made-up inputs hold the 3 members, red 3 of 3 before the change; the wrapper is not a member, since it does not change what is built
